name: The Great Drowning
desc:
In the year 904 CE, the Celtorian capital, the Great City of Celtor, was devastated and sunk by a colossal sea monster known only as the 'Celtorian Horror'. A new king rose to power and seemingly through the machinations of [the Ministry](faction:the_ministry), the Celtorian Horror dragged the city beneath the waves. Following the submergence of Celtor, much of the rest of the Southern Luminant was pulled under the waves and consumed by the [Voidsea](location:voidsea).

The city was drowned as an offering to [Yun'Shul](entity:yunshul_keeper_of_hearts), though they did not care for the surprise gift and did not give the Ministry any reward for it. [The City of Celtor](location:the_city_of_the_drowned) is now located in [Scyphozia, The first Layer of The Depths](location:first_layer). The Depths became the place souls went to after death after the Great Drowning.

Based on [Jericho's](entity:warden_jericho) journal, the Kingdom of [Etrea](faction:etrea)'s current rulings may cause a great war; eventually leading to another Great Drowning.
